name: External Identity Provider Registration Success
summary: A new user establishes a durable account from a validated supported external identity provider identity, binds that provider identity to the new user, and enters the application without conflating provider email with independent email ownership evidence.
finalOutcome: A new durable user exists, the external provider identity is bound to it, the required home context exists, and an authenticated application session is active.

sourceReferences.note: Legacy journey provides discovery evidence and retains historical terminology until its own reconciliation.
External Identity Provider is the canonical terminology for provider-mediated identity establishment.
